source_document: UWC General Admissions Criteria for 2027 (8-panel brochure)

application_periods.label: General
application_periods.notes: Applications open 1-2 April 2026 (brochure: 2 April) and close 30 September 2026. Dentistry & Oral Health close 31 August 2026 per UWC's application page. Admission is based on final Grade 12 results (January 2027).

default_scale.name: UWC points: all other subjects (incl. Maths Literacy)

aps_rule.notes: UWC weighted points: English and Mathematics up to 15, Life Orientation up to 3, every other subject (Maths Literacy included) up to 8. Six subjects plus Life Orientation.
